subject: note on spam filtering on nimble-users

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: note on spam filtering on nimble-users
parts:
Hi everyone,

Just so list members are aware, Google's spam filter has for some reason been more active in flagging posts as possible spam recently.  We (nimble developers / list moderators) are not trying to hold up postings or filter what gets posted, but sometimes it takes a day or two or more to see that something has been placed on hold by Google.  If you've tried to post something and don't see it appear on the list, feel free to email me directly to ask to check if it got stuck in Google's spam filter. Thanks all for contributing on the list.

Perry
